summary: The diff implements most of the requested requirements (REQ-30 through REQ-35). REQ-30 spacing gap is added in HomePage.tsx. REQ-31/32/33 bank selection bottom sheet is implemented via new BankSelectionSheet, BankRow, and BankLogos components, triggered after PIN validation. REQ-34 and REQ-35 are implemented in PaymentSuccessPage.tsx with phase-based button transitions. One notable addition is an interactive bank selection state not requested. REQ-35's button swap timing appears to occur at 10s rather than the 5s mark described in the spec.

hallucinated_features.description: Bank selection sheet includes an interactive row selection state (selectedBank state with visual highlight on the selected row) allowing the user to toggle between HDFC and SBI banks.
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-32 and REQ-33 describe showing two bank rows with Cancel/Continue buttons but do not mention interactive row selection or a highlighted selected state. The implementation adds a selectable state with visual feedback not requested.

hallucinated_features.description: PaymentSuccessPage introduces a Phase 3 at the 10-second mark that swaps buttons, rather than swapping at the same 5-second Phase 2 reveal.
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-35 states the swap happens after 5 seconds ('a second timer or the same Phase 2 reveal'), but the file summary describes a Phase 3 at 10s+, adding an unrequested additional timed phase.
